other_conditions: Must belong to a religious minority in Karnataka.
Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
No family member should be employed in the Central or State Government.
No loan from Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation in the last five years, except the Arivu Education Loan Scheme.
benefits_summary: Loan up to ₹5,00,000 per unit, with 50% provided as subsidy and 50% as a repayable loan.
